**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in TUBB1 associated with neuropathy phenotypes and pathogenic variants in CCT5 associated with macrothrombocytopenia phenotypes, without evidence of cross-phenotype association, would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: The presence of common, benign variants in TUBB1 (associated with neuropathy) or CCT5 (associated with macrothrombocytopenia) in the general population (gnomAD).)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of cytoskeletal integrity in both neurological and hematological disorders could reveal novel therapeutic targets for conditions affecting disparate organ systems but arising from a common molecular pathway.
